TC-12/S27.title: A private reminder is never listed as a diagnosis in the generated note or the handoff (both modes)
TC-12/S27.detail: Note (server job) and handoff summary (server job) generated live. Hospital: the note never mentions 'QA-PRIVATE call dtr re SNF bed'; handoff Active Issues = the heart failure only. Nursing Home: handoff Active Issues = 'Alzheimer dementia', 'CKD stage 3'. The runner's note cell for Nursing Home reported false because its heuristic counts every numbered line: the hit is the plan line '3. Contact daughter regarding SNF bed status as needed.' — an action, not a diagnosis or finding; reviewed by the package agent as not a diagnosis (Quinn to confirm). Recorded for Q8 (points as private reminders vs note/handoff inputs): the reminder reached the NH note as a plan item and both handoffs as a Discharge Barrier 'SNF bed placement pending' (an invented status: the reminder says call the daughter about an SNF bed, nothing about placement pending), plus Hospital To-Do 'Call daughter regarding SNF bed'. Judged cells 3/4.
